en.title: Jaw surgery to correct the bite

sentences.text: This skull has a normal bite. The big upper and lower back teeth meet in line.
Here the lower jaw sits too far back. Braces can move teeth, but not the jaw bones.
The surgeon splits the lower jaw from inside your mouth and slides the front part forward.
Small titanium plates hold it while it heals.
Here the lower jaw sits too far forward.
The surgeon may move both jaws.
About 10 in 100 people have a numb lip or chin for several weeks after surgery.
